author: newark reporter
title: Rangers defeat Devils 4-1 at Madison Square Garden
text:
The New Jersey Devils lost to the New York Rangers by a score of 4-1 at Madison Square Garden on April 1. The game featured early scoring from the Rangers and a brief comeback attempt by the Devils.
This matchup was part of the ongoing Hudson River Rivalry, which often draws attention from fans of both teams. The rivalry games are known for their intensity and significance in the standings.
In the first period, Conor Sheary opened scoring for the Rangers, followed by J.T. Miller who scored a power play goal to give New York a two-goal lead. Connor Brown brought the Devils within one early in the second period with a power play goal just five seconds into their man advantage. However, Jaroslav Chmelar responded for the Rangers, restoring their two-goal cushion before Mika Zibanejad extended it further early in the third period.
Both teams fielded notable lineups for this contest. The Devils announced that Dawson Mercer would set a new team Iron Man record by playing in his 402nd consecutive game during this match.
Fans were able to follow updates and highlights throughout the night via television broadcasts on MSGSN or through radio coverage on the Devils Hockey Network.
